reviews.review_title: You've sent me a battery that doesn't…
reviews.review_text:
You've sent me a battery that doesn't work but won't give me a refund. The video I sent clearly shows the phone doesn't boot.
Following the reply from Ali express, I must add to this review that you already investigated my case and dismissed it. The evidence that I was to provide included a video and photos. I couldn't upload a video so I provided you with a link to it. Eventually having uploaded a highly compressed video that shows the phone booting with the old battery and not booting with the new battery, you dismissed my claim. I also sent photos of the product. What other evidence I can give apart from having the battery professionally tested I dont know. Your system seems structured to avoid complaint!
reviews.reply_text:
Dear Customer,

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the product you received that is not functioning as expected. We have already begun investigating the issue and will provide you with updates via email as soon as possible. Please keep an eye on your inbox for further communication.

If you have any additional details or supporting information regarding the issue, please feel free to share it with us through this email thread or via our Help Center. Your cooperation and patience throughout this process are greatly appreciated.

Thank you for bringing this matter to our attention, and we apologize once again for any frustration this may have caused.

Best regards,

AliExpress Customer Service Team
